ctaHeading: Need a Leak Detector in Alphington?
aboutText: With over 35 years of experience, Balcony & Bathroom Leak Detection is Alphington's most trusted specialist in finding and fixing hidden leaks. We help homeowners, property managers, and builders prevent costly water damage, lower bills, and protect homes from mold and structural issues. Our advanced technology and local expertise ensure accurate, non-invasive detection across Melbourne's northern suburbs.
servicesText: From hidden pipe leaks to balcony waterproofing, we use state-of-the-art equipment to locate problems without damage. Our team provides timely repairs and advice to keep your property safe and dry in Alphington and beyond.

services.title: Water Leak Detection
services.desc: Using acoustic and thermal imaging to find hidden leaks in walls, floors, and ceilings without invasive methods.

services.title: Pipe Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Efficient repair or replacement of damaged pipes to stop leaks and prevent further water damage in your home.

services.title: Balcony Waterproofing
services.desc: Expert waterproofing solutions for balconies to prevent water ingress and structural damage in Alphington properties.

services.title: Bathroom Leak Fixes
services.desc: Specialised detection and repair for bathroom leaks, including around showers, tubs, and fixtures.

services.title: Mold Prevention & Consultation
services.desc: Identifying moisture sources and providing recommendations to prevent mold growth and maintain a healthy environment.

services.title: Emergency Leak Services
services.desc: 24/7 emergency response for urgent leak situations to minimise damage and restore safety quickly.
